📰 General

FBI Investigating Rep. Eric Swalwell as Part of Trump Administration Push •

The FBI is reportedly investigating California Rep. Eric Swalwell as part of an initiative led by the Trump administration. The investigation centers on an old investigation related to allegations that surfaced during Swalwell’s 2018 congressional campaign. The Washington Post reported the administration’s request for the FBI to revisit the matter, focusing on the existing investigation. Swalwell, a prominent Democratic candidate for California governor, is currently under scrutiny as a result of this renewed inquiry.

🌍 World

Rubio’s “Lunatics” Remark Sparks Controversy Following Trump’s Assessment •

Former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo stated that the United States is engaged in negotiations with Iran, describing the process as “productive.” This statement followed remarks by Donald Trump who characterized the Iranian government as a “new and more reasonable regime.” Senator Marco Rubio criticized the assessment, asserting that the U.S. is negotiating with “lunatics.” The differing viewpoints highlight a significant divergence in strategy regarding the ongoing Middle East conflict.

🦅 US

Micron Stock Plummets as Massive Rally Ends in Dramatic Bear Market Shift •

Micron Technology’s stock experienced a significant decline following a remarkable 666% rally, marking a swift transition into a bear market scenario. The downturn occurred despite the company reporting its strongest quarterly performance to date. Analysts attribute the rapid reversal to heightened expectations within the market. The stock price fell sharply, reflecting a change in investor sentiment after a period of extraordinary gains.

💰 Business

JetBlue Increases Checked Bag Fees Following Rising Fuel Costs and Middle East Conflict •

JetBlue Airways announced a minimum $4 increase in checked baggage fees, citing rising jet fuel prices driven by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. The airline’s decision follows the U.S. and Israel’s coordinated attack on Iran on February 28th. This price hike reflects a broader trend of increased airfare globally due to elevated fuel costs. Analysts suggest the conflict has significantly impacted the aviation industry’s operational expenses.

💻 Technology

Apple Intelligence Now Available in China Following Extended Delay •

Apple has begun rolling out its Apple Intelligence features to users in China, marking the first time the AI tools are available outside of the United States. This launch follows a nearly 18-month delay since the initial October 2024 US release. Reports indicate this rollout was initially unplanned, according to Mark Gurman, suggesting a shift in Apple’s AI strategy. The timing of the China launch remains unclear, but it represents a significant expansion of the technology.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala, held at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City. She wore a custom-designed, light-pink gown by Valentino, featuring a dramatic cape and intricate embellishments. The dress was praised by fashion critics and social media users alike for its innovative design and Zendaya’s confident presentation. The event, themed “Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion,” drew celebrities and influencers from around the world.

🏅 Sports

2028 Los Angeles Olympics Ticket Sales Launching Soon – Here’s How to Secure Your Seats •

Ticket sales for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games will begin this week, offering fans the opportunity to purchase seats in advance. The virtual ticket box opens on April 2nd, initially prioritizing residents of Southern California and Oklahoma. LA28 anticipates high demand and encourages fans to register for notifications regarding the official launch. The organization plans to utilize a phased rollout of ticket sales to manage demand and ensure a fair process for all interested buyers.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Artemis II Mission: Astronauts Prepare for Historic Moon Launch This Week •

NASA is on track for a potential launch of the Artemis II mission this week, marking the first crewed mission to the moon since the Apollo 17 mission in 1972. The four-person crew, including the mission’s pilot, Reid Wiseman, will embark on a roughly five-day journey around the moon. This mission’s primary objective is to test the systems needed for future crewed lunar landings. The crew will conduct observations and experiments during their orbital flight, paving the way for the Artemis III mission which aims to land astronauts on the moon’s surface.

🩺 Health

Five Supplements Linked to Elevated Blood Pressure – What to Avoid •

Research indicates several commonly available supplements can negatively impact individuals with hypertension. Specifically, beta-carotene, vitamin E, niacin, riboflavin, and vitamin B6 have been associated with increased blood pressure levels in some studies. These supplements appear to stimulate the release of vasoconstrictors, substances that narrow blood vessels and raise pressure. Individuals with high blood pressure should consult with a healthcare professional before taking any supplements.
